items.title: Die-cut / behind-the-page BRIDGEt
items.why: Layout was rolled back on purpose. Restoring it breaks the elite page.
items.next: Do not reintroduce bridget-cutout, PageDieCut, or diecut CSS.

items.title: Door page transition
items.why: Ident splash is the only allowed first-load motion.
items.next: Do not restore a door or route-change overlay.

items.title: Required legal pages
items.why: Privacy, terms, AI use, accessibility, HIPAA, GLBA, and the security program must stay public.
items.next: Keep footer links and pages in sync.

items.title: BRIDGEt face must stay locked
items.why: A second statue or bust splits the brand. Paths live in BRIDGET_AVATAR.
items.next: Import BRIDGET_AVATAR. Do not hardcode /brand/bridget/avatar-* in JSX.

items.title: Preview widget is still a facade
items.why: This preview tree greets and hands off. Signed ElevenLabs sessions live on production, not here.
items.next: Do not fake a live voice session in the preview. Production uses /api/bridget.

items.title: Live transfer env not on this preview
items.why: Production /api/twilio/token returns 503 until Twilio vars are set on insureitall-website-pcgn.
items.next: Set Production Twilio env on the Vercel project that serves insureitall-llc.com, then redeploy.

items.title: Console usage metrics are illustrative
items.why: Moot — the staff console (and its illustrative usage/session charts) was extracted to BRIDGEt Console, a separate multi-tenant repo. Nothing in this repo renders sample KPIs anymore.
items.next: Do not rebuild a staff console UI in this repo. BRIDGEt Console owns its own real-vs-illustrative data honesty.

items.title: Next.js artifacts tree is not the preview
items.why: Editing artifacts/insureitall-website does not change this preview.
items.next: Change root src/ and public/ only.

items.title: Unused BRIDGEt exploration stills
items.why: Clay experiments and extra statues stay on disk. The locked face is avatar-clean / avatar-bust.
items.next: Do not swap the locked assets. Archive extras only with an explicit ask.
